Plot factor scores for multiple methods (scatter grid)

Source: R/plots.R
plot_scores_scatter_grid.Rd

Produces a grid of scatter plots (one panel per method) showing factor scores per sample, coloured by a metadata grouping variable. When align_to is set, each non-reference method automatically displays its matched factor — i.e. the factor most correlated (by |r|) with factor factor_idx of the reference method — and its sign is flipped if the raw correlation is negative. Use align_to = NULL to disable matching and plot each method's factor factor_idx as-is.

Usage

plot_scores_scatter_grid(
  bench,
  factor_idx = 1,
  group_col = "Treatment",
  methods = NULL,
  panel_tags = NULL,
  tag_position = c("tl_in", "none"),
  title_text = "Factor scores",
  palette = NULL,
  legend_position = "right",
  align_to = "auto",
  ncol = NULL
)

Arguments

bench

Named list returned by attach_scores_metadata().

factor_idx

Integer. Factor index to display for the reference method (align_to). Other methods will show their best-matching factor.

group_col

Character. Column from scores_with_meta for colouring.

methods

Character vector of method names to plot. NULL (default) uses every method that has scores_with_meta.

panel_tags

Optional character vector of panel labels (one per method).

tag_position

"tl_in" (default) or "none".

title_text

Character. Figure title.

palette

Optional named colour vector for groups.

legend_position

Legend position string (default "right").

align_to

Character. Reference method for factor matching and sign alignment. "auto" (default) uses MOFA when present, otherwise the first method. Set NULL to disable.

ncol

Number of panel columns (default 2).

Value

A patchwork ggplot object.
